snippet.title: Level 300 Druid vs Thrymm the Storm King | Zarethia Gameplay
snippet.description:
Ice magic and healing circles: a level 300 druid hunts Stormcrown Peaks, its caves and ledges, and brings down Thrymm the Storm King.

Stormcrown Peaks: Storm Giants and Thunderbirds
Floor −1, Thunder Caves: Thunderbirds and Storm Bats
Floor +1, Cloud Ledges: Thunderbirds and Sky Rams
Boss: Thrymm the Storm King, level 303

Zarethia is a free pixel-art MMORPG for Android and PC: https://zarethia.com
